covered.rule: 1. First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 10, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2. Never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
3. Clear yes/speaking/own name; ask once more; not_reached/unclear
4. Robot reply / scam reply and continue
5. Third party: say nothing about purpose, ask when reachable
6. Callback today or next business day 12:00-17:30, later than now; not_reached/callback
7. Time outside window: ask once more; not_reached/no_callback
8. Wrong number: not_reached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: 'I am sorry for your loss.' not_reached/deceased
10. Refuses to talk: no_promise/refused
11. company_number (4 digits), founded_year (year), postcode (text) in order
12. 4 wrong answers in total; use wrong_answers_left
13. 'Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.' not_verified/failed
14. Decline / asking purpose: explain once; second refusal not_verified/declined
15. Human during identity check: ask once, general, transferred/human
16. now as clock; Mon-Fri; holidays
17. Next/this weekday
18. Collections team intro; up to 4 products; state all; ask once pay all today
covered.where: phrases.debt_intro, multi_product.max_products, multi_product.state_all_before_asking, multi_product.ask_all_today_once, phrases.all_today_question, phrases.today_question

covered.rule: 19. Product types, floors, spoken names
20. Full first, never ask how much, floor..full accepted, floor once 'the rest stays overdue'
21. Promise date validation, roll forward, vague date, after deadline
23. Attempt 1 full on last business day this/next week (floor if full refused); attempt 2 floor on deadline
24. Attempts used up: note refused
25. Already paid sentence, note paid, continue
26. Dispute: note dispute, continue
27. Hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer support transfer; decline no_promise/hardship; may still record promise
28. Restructuring: transfer restructuring; promises stay
29. Human after verification
30. Read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
31. Text message sentence after successful write
32. create_promise fails: no retry, no_promise/service_error
33. 'You can change it in the mobile app.'
34. Same call, common date clamped, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
35. One note per unpromised product; reasons; no notes on transfer
36. Goodbye before close_call; outcome/reason table
37. Outcome precedence
